description: This is the main Program.cs source file for an ASP.NET Core web API application. It configures services, middleware, health checks, and endpoint mappings for a data asset management backend system, including assets, copy lineage, statuses, properties, control mappings, reporting attributes, input parameters, and nested relationships.
